pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark patches exhibit high-contrast, jagged edges with sharp pixel gradients. Geometry is predominantly polygonal and stellate, with larger spatial areas on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, more densely packed regions toward the rump.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored interstices form a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are clearly defined where three or four patches meet. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the neck but narrows into thin, sharp lines between the larger flank patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. Individual hair tufts create a jagged 1D geometric contour against the sky, which becomes less distinct over the shoulder ridge.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A visible discontinuity in the mane profile is present at the junction where the neck meets the shoulder, showing a localized flattening of the otherwise serrated line.
